What this is, and what it is not

This is an educational map of blood tests, built for curiosity and for better conversations with a clinician. It does not diagnose, does not recommend tests, and does not know your medical history.

The ranked list is labelled “worth asking your doctor about” deliberately. It reflects topical relevance between your answers and each test's stated purpose — not a clinical recommendation, and not data about who actually gets tested.
